title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
description: Discover ten distinct study environments across the Colby College campus, from the 24-hour 'Street' in Miller Library to the light-filled forums of the Gordon Center.

cards.title: The Street at Miller Library
cards.subtitle: 24-Hour Study Hub
cards.notes: Head to the lowest level of Miller Library for 24-hour access to individual and group study spaces, ideal for late-night sessions.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour study area located on the lowest level of Miller Library featuring diverse seating for individuals and groups.
cards.evidence_claim: The lowest level of Miller, known as “The Street,” features individual and group study spaces and is open 24 hours daily.

cards.title: Brewster Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Classic Academic Atmosphere
cards.notes: Visit the first floor of Miller Library to study in this traditional reading room designed for quiet, focused academic work.
cards.short_summary: A traditional quiet reading room located on the first floor of the main campus library.
cards.evidence_claim: Miller Library's Brewster Reading Room is highlighted as a key study space on the first floor.

cards.title: Olin Science Library
cards.subtitle: Quiet Science Hub
cards.notes: Enter through the potted plants to find large study carrels and group rooms in this quiet library dedicated to the sciences.
cards.short_summary: A quiet library space in the Olin Science Center featuring study carrels and group study rooms.
cards.evidence_claim: Olin is the science library on campus featuring large study carrels, tables for group work, and group study rooms.
cards.access_notes: Open during posted library hours; quieter alternative to Miller.

cards.title: Bixler Art and Music Library
cards.subtitle: Sunlit Creative Space
cards.notes: Utilize the digital media lab or find a table near the large windows for a bright, uplifting study environment in Bixler.
cards.short_summary: A specialized library for art and music featuring a digital media lab and sunlit study areas.
cards.evidence_claim: Bixler Art and Music Library features a digital media lab and study spaces with windows that allow for natural light.
cards.access_notes: Open during library hours; houses the digital media lab.

cards.title: Pulver Pavilion
cards.subtitle: Social Study Commons
cards.notes: Find informal seating for 113 people in this central student hub, located near the Spa snack bar in Cotter Union.
cards.short_summary: A large, informal study and social space located within the Cotter Union student center.
cards.evidence_claim: Pulver Pavilion features a variety of informal spaces and has a seating capacity of 113.
cards.source_title: The Residential Experience: Student Life and Services | Colby College
cards.access_notes: Open daily; high foot traffic area near dining and the bookstore.

cards.title: Olentine Forum
cards.subtitle: Modern Arts Hub
cards.notes: Study in the light-filled forum of the Gordon Center, a hub for student interaction connecting the building's performance venues.
cards.short_summary: A modern, light-filled student interaction and study space within the Gordon Center for Creative and Performing Arts.
cards.evidence_claim: The light-filled Olentine Forum connects the main venues and is a hub for student interaction.
cards.source_title: Colby College - Gordon Center for Creative & Performing Arts
cards.access_notes: Accessible during building hours for the arts departments.

cards.title: Grossman Hall Social Commons
cards.subtitle: Career-Focused Study Area
cards.notes: Access the career resources library and social commons in this renovated space, also home to the DavisConnects program.
cards.short_summary: A social commons and career resources library located in the renovated Grossman Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: A career resources library and social commons are located in the extension of Grossman Hall.

cards.title: Diamond Building TEAL Rooms
cards.subtitle: Collaborative Tech Spaces
cards.notes: Use the breakout areas and large monitors in Technology-Enabled Active Learning (TEAL) rooms for group projects and screen sharing.
cards.short_summary: Collaborative classrooms in the Diamond Building equipped with breakout stations and monitors for group work.
cards.evidence_claim: TEAL classrooms include breakout areas with large monitors for students to work together in groups.
cards.access_notes: Available when classes are not in session; features movable furniture.

cards.title: Greene Block + Studios
cards.subtitle: Downtown Arts Space
cards.notes: Study in the heart of downtown Waterville at this multidisciplinary arts space featuring a book and print makerspace.
cards.short_summary: A multidisciplinary arts programming space in downtown Waterville with public study and makerspace areas.
cards.evidence_claim: The 1st floor features multidisciplinary arts programming and a book and print makerspace open to the public.
cards.access_notes: Located at 18 Main Street; check website for current public hours.

cards.title: Johnson Pond Outdoor Area
cards.subtitle: Scenic Outdoor Study
cards.notes: Grab an Adirondack chair by the water for a peaceful outdoor study session with views of the campus's most iconic landmark.
cards.short_summary: A scenic outdoor area by Johnson Pond featuring Adirondack chairs for quiet reading and study.
cards.evidence_claim: Johnson Pond is described as a quiet spot with Adirondack chairs available for sitting and reading.
cards.source_title: A quiet spot by Johnson Pond - Colby College
cards.access_notes: Best during daylight hours in fair weather.
